name: ux-grandmaster
description: A design methodology plugin for AI agents: frame, research, design, critique, verify.
author: Kemal Salih Carfi

scripts.check: npm test && node scripts/check-skills.mjs && node scripts/build-platforms.mjs --check && npm run scan:secrets
scripts.scan:secrets: if command -v gitleaks >/dev/null 2>&1; then gitleaks dir . --no-banner && gitleaks git . --no-banner; else echo "gitleaks not installed: secret scan skipped"; fi
